news.title: Waaree Renewable Technologies Limited (BSE:534618) enter into a binding term sheet to acquire an unknown stake in Associated Power Structures Limited.
news.body:
Waaree Renewable Technologies Limited (BSE:534618) enter into a binding term sheet to acquire an unknown stake in Associated Power Structures Limited on January 26, 2026. A cash consideration will be paid by Waaree Renewable Technologies Limited. Waaree Renewable will acquire 55% of the stake in the equity share capital of Associated Power Structures Limited for a total consideration of INR ~12.25 billion mix of primary & secondary acquisition.

For the period ending March 31, 2025, Associated Power Structures Limited reported total revenue of INR 12.27 billion. As of March 31, 2025, Associated Power Structures Limited reported total assets of INR 8.34 billion and total common equity of INR 3.4 billion.
